exposure: History of emergency cesarean delivery (yes or no)
Women with a history of emergency CD
Virtual reality video demonstrating cesarean delivery
cohort: 97 women scheduled for elective cesarean delivery at term
finding: While the VR video did not significantly reduce preoperative anxiety overall, it did improve feelings of preparedness and showed a trend towards anxiety reduction in women with a history of emergency CD.
mod_finding: While a VR video did not reduce preoperative anxiety for planned cesarean deliveries overall, it showed a trend toward decreased anxiety in women with a history of emergency cesarean delivery.
